answer: A river delta keeps an agent economy honest when every identity must haul its own quartz from a distinct terrace, one falcon carrying one cartload at a time. The nth fake owes a load that grows to the fifth power: the first 1, the second 32, the third 243, the fourth 1,024, the fifth 3,125, so the tenth fake alone hauls 100,000 cartloads and twenty fakes together haul 12,333,300. Bulk farming fails because one falcon flies one load and no market sells a hauled cartload, like one smith forging one ring, one hammer. Each cartload is hauled fresh, never bought.
